project_type: Marketing website for DEMAze Technologies. TanStack Start (SSR) single-page-per-route app on Vite 8, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4. Supabase powers contact + playbook forms via TanStack server functions. Deployed to Railway with the Nitro node-server preset.
build_system: Vite 8 via the @lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config wrapper. vite.config.ts calls defineConfig from that wrapper, which ALREADY bundles tanstackStart, viteReact, tailwindcss, tsConfigPaths, nitro, VITE_* env injection, the @ path alias, and React/TanStack dedupe. NEVER re-add those plugins manually or the build breaks with duplicate-plugin errors. Extra Vite config must go through the wrapper's escape hatch: defineConfig({ tanstackStart: {...}, nitro: {...}, vite: {...} }). Nitro preset is node-server (Railway/Node), NOT cloudflare.
test_framework: vitest (run via `npm test` = `vitest run`), jsdom env available. Existing tests: src/lib/site-data.test.ts (asserts services length 4, projects.length >= 16, metrics length 4, technologies length 8, industries.length >= 15, each service description > 80 chars and items >= 6, each project.image truthy) and src/lib/submission-guards.test.ts (per-IP rate limiting + human-timing guards).
build_command: npm run build (vite build, SSR). CANNOT run locally in this sandbox: node_modules lacks tool binaries (.bin/vite absent) and the npm registry is unreachable (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, 403). CI validates it.
test_command: npm test (vitest run). Same local limitation. CI validates it.
verification_instructions: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs exactly four checks on push/PR, in order, and is the AUTHORITATIVE gate: 1) npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), 2) npm run lint (eslint .), 3) npm test (vitest run), 4) npm run build (vite build). Any new npm dependency MUST be added to BOTH package.json and package-lock.json in sync, because CI uses `npm ci` which fails if the lockfile is out of sync with package.json. None of these four can be executed inside the sandbox; code must be made type-correct and lint-clean by construction and validated by CI.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/assets/images.ts is GENERATED by `npm run images` (scripts/optimize-images.mjs, uses sharp) and pairs each imported image URL with intrinsic width/height {src,width,height}. src/routeTree.gen.ts is GENERATED by the TanStack router plugin. NEVER hand-edit either. sharp/npm are unavailable in-sandbox, so no new source art can be processed here; reuse existing entries in images.ts.
setup_instructions: Normally `npm install` then `npm run dev` (port 8080). NOT possible in this sandbox (no registry access, no tool binaries). Do not attempt installs or retry them.
environment_constraints: NETWORK MODE = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. The public npm registry is UNREACHABLE (npm install / npm ci / npx fail with 403). node_modules currently LACKS tool binaries (no .bin/vite, tsc, eslint, vitest). CONSEQUENCE: new 3D/animation deps (three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, gsap, etc.) CANNOT be installed here, and the four CI checks + dev server CANNOT run here. Do NOT treat this as a bug or retry installs. Write all code type-correct and lint-clean by construction; add new deps to package.json AND package-lock.json in sync; rely on CI as validator. Cannot fetch external web design references either; use established immersive-web patterns from prior knowledge.
contribution_requirements: This repo syncs to Lovable (AGENTS.md): NEVER force-push, rebase, amend, or squash already-pushed commits. Keep the branch in a working (compilable) state at every commit. All rebuild work happens on branch rebuild/immersive-3d (already created off main). Do NOT commit to main. The orchestrator pushes/opens the PR; the coder commits locally only. Prettier is enforced via eslint-plugin-prettier (see .prettierrc); code must be prettier-clean. eslint config: react-hooks recommended, react-refresh only-export-components as warn, no-restricted-imports blocks the `server-only` package.
key_patterns: Content model in src/lib/site-data.ts is REAL, honest content (a prior audit removed fabricated metrics; keep them honest, do NOT invent data). Exports: projects (16 entries: title/description/features[]/image), services (4: id/number/title/image/description/items[]), technologies (8 [name,image]), industries (19 [name,string[]]), values (4), process (4), faqs (5), metrics (exactly 4). Images imported from @/assets/images (SiteImage type = {src,width,height}) and spread onto to prevent layout shift. Server functions via createServerFn (src/lib/forms.functions.ts). Security headers + CSP + immutable /assets/** caching live in src/server.ts (the Lovable wrapper does not expose Nitro routeRules); current CSP is strict same-origin. Fonts self-hosted via @fontsource-variable, preloaded in __root.tsx. Existing motion is IntersectionObserver + rAF scroll handlers that all honor prefers-reduced-motion. Routes are file-based in src/routes/. ui primitives (button/input/textarea/accordion) use class-variance-authority + cn() from src/lib/utils.ts.
relevant_files: vite.config.ts (Lovable wrapper - do not add plugins)
src/server.ts (CSP + security headers - widen CSP here for any new asset/worker/wasm/blob source)
src/routes/__root.tsx (shell, head meta, font preloads, providers - GENERATED sibling routeTree.gen.ts must not be edited)
src/components/content-sections.tsx (all shared section components + metric counters)
src/components/hero-video.tsx (self-hosted hero video with offscreen-pause + reduced-motion)
src/lib/site-data.ts (REAL content - preserve invariants asserted by site-data.test.ts)
src/lib/site-data.test.ts (content invariants - update deliberately only if restructuring)
src/styles.css (3571 lines - Tailwind v4 @theme tokens + all component styles)
package.json + package-lock.json (add new deps to BOTH in sync for npm ci)
directory_structure: src/routes/ = file-based routes (index, about-us, services, projects, contact-us, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, ai-dev-automation-playbook, ai-dev-automation-playbook-form, __root; routeTree.gen.ts generated). src/components/ = shared React components + ui/ primitives. src/lib/ = site-data, server functions, guards, utils, error handling. src/assets/ = original/ source art + generated images.ts + hero video/poster. src/styles.css = single global stylesheet (Tailwind v4). public/ = favicons, manifest, robots, sitemap, social preview. scripts/ = image + icon generation (sharp/ffmpeg). Deploy: railway.json + Nitro node-server.
